The maximum number of entries to return for a single query.

Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 30.

description.zh: 用来标记开始查询数据的位置。置空表示从头开始。
description.en: The token that specifies the position from which the query starts. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning.

title.zh: 查询配额用量告警历史记录

descriptions.zh: 配额告警功能已升级，本API即将废弃，本API仅可查询旧版配额用量告警历史记录，若您想查询新版配额用量告警历史记录，请您使用云监控API [DescribeAlertLogCount](~~2513275~~)、[DescribeAlertLogList](~~2513276~~)进行操作。使用API对新版配额告警进行操作的更多信息，请参见[使用API管理新版配额告警](~~2863234~~)。
descriptions.en: This API is deprecated because the quota alert feature has been upgraded. It queries only the alert history for the previous version of Quota Center. To query the alert history for the current version, use the Cloud Monitor APIs [DescribeAlertLogCount](~~2513275~~) and [DescribeAlertLogList](~~2513276~~). For more information, see [Use APIs to manage alerts for the current version of Quota Center](~~2863234~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun quotas list-alarm-histories --next-token 1 --max-results 30 --keyword Quantity --start-time 20201020 --end-time 20201024 --product-code ecs --alarm-id 18b3be23-b7b0-4d45-91bc-d0c331aa0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun quotas ListAlarmHistories --region cn-hangzhou --AlarmId '18b3be23-b7b0-4d45-91bc-d0c331aa0000' --NextToken 1 --Keyword Quantity --EndTime 20201024 --ProductCode ecs --MaxResults 30 --StartTime 20201020
